theorems.name: Submission.imc_weightedTangent_iff_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (θ : Eucl N → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet E (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ K) < ∞) → (∀ x ∈ E, 0 < θ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl N), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (E ∩ K) (μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl N), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E θ x Q ↔ Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt k E x Q
